# Task map

Each question a newcomer asked about snapy is listed here once, under what the book says about it: answered,
partly documented, undocumented, unsupported by the code, or outside the scope of this report. A listed section
is the best place to start; a partly documented answer also says what is not yet covered.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Find where the book answers a "How do I ...?" question, or why it does not.

**Data.** `tools/task-map.yaml`: one record per question, with a status and a section or a reason.

**Placement.** Report preparation, outside the solver.

**Activation.** Run `gen_task_map.py`; no solver switch.

**Guarantee / limits.** Every question has one record; a status records the lookup test, not a code audit.

**Evidence.** `tools/tests/test_task_map.py` fails on a missing question and on a section that does not exist.
:::

**Delivered Wave 3 standards pieces.**

The four in-scope pieces are delivered; their existing sections are the destinations:

- Conventions: @sec-appa-conventions.
- Output contract: @sec-ch14-netcdf, @sec-ch14-pnetcdf and @sec-ch14-restart.
- H2-He thermodynamic assumptions: @sec-ch02-ideal-moist and @sec-ch02-moist-mixture.
- Initial-state contract: @sec-ch01-initialization.

These delivery notes do not re-grade the broader newcomer questions below. Their
lookup grades remain unchanged pending the held-out re-test; tutorial and
cross-model requests retain their stated limits.
